events.explanation: The projected opening screen disappears while several people cross the foreground. This is projection setup/blanking, not another informational slide.
events.uncertainty: The sample contains simultaneous screen blanking and foreground motion, so it cannot isolate which feature triggered this boundary.

events.explanation: The same Windows desktop and projection-mode panel remain visible; the lower desktop/taskbar display changes during setup. No presentation page changes.
events.uncertainty: This is a computer-display setup interval. The exact contribution of the small UI change and room-camera noise is not isolated.

events.explanation: A masked attendee passes very close to the camera and then leaves. The projected About Me slide stays the same in the source pair and retained frame.
events.uncertainty: Foreground occlusion is visible; its precise share of the detector response is not measured.

events.explanation: The projected dataset slide has the same three labeled steps before, at and after the event and in the retained image. No new information is visibly added.
events.uncertainty: The sample establishes duplicate visible content but does not isolate the exact trigger; projection/camera changes and OCR instability are not separately measured.

events.explanation: The presenter walks from in front of the projected Moran calculation slide toward the lectern; the two plots and slide text remain unchanged.
events.uncertainty: Presenter position and occlusion visibly change, while subtle source-camera variation is not isolated.

events.explanation: The same Taiwan map remains projected while the presenter changes stance and gesture beside it. The retained image shows the same map.
events.uncertainty: The sample supports presenter motion without a new map state; it does not establish that every unsampled extra has this cause.

events.explanation: The same PowerPoint editing view and closing slide remain projected while a black-shirted attendee enters the foreground; the retained frame contains that passerby.
events.uncertainty: Foreground motion is visible. No new slide content is apparent, and the exact detector trigger is not isolated.

events.explanation: The projection is already blank before and after the event; attendees move and pack up in front of the empty whiteboard. The final retained image has no new informational page.
events.uncertainty: This is motion in the room at the end of the recording, not a new screen state with useful slide content.
